products.name: Sunshine Pro High Speed Multi-Head Embroidery Machine
products.description: Heavy-duty high speed multi-head computer embroidery machine engineered for precise motif work, garments, sarees, caps, and badges with Dahao smart touch computer control.

specifications.Thread Trimming: Automatic Thread Trimmer & Thread Break Sensor
specifications.Motor: Servo Motor for Main Drive and Pantograph
specifications.Hook Type: Koban Original High Speed Rotary Hook (Japan)

features: High-precision linear guide rail for smooth pantograph frame movement
Automatic color change and top/bottom thread breakage detection
Integrated cap & garment embroidery attachment kit
Emergency stop button with auto stitch restoration after power cut
Heavy-duty vibration damping steel frame structure

products.name: Sunshine FU Type Compact Embroidery Machine
products.description: Specialized FU type structure embroidery machine providing high stability for heavy fabrics, thick threads, and intricate sequin/beading work.
features: FU Type extra rigid chassis prevents frame flex during high speed runs
Specialized thread tensioners for metallic and rayon threads
Automatic bobbin winder integrated on head assembly
Supports DST, DSB, EXP design file formats

products.name: Sunshine Large Frame Flat Embroidery Machine
products.description: Expansive large frame flat computer embroidery machine designed for continuous fabric rolls, large bedsheets, curtains, and high volume manufacturing.
features: Extra large embroidery field ideal for continuous panel embroidery
Double noise-reduction cover casing
Auto-trimming and auto-color change
Dahao computer system with network USB input

products.name: Sunshine Butterfly Model Single Head Embroidery Machine
products.description: Compact, portable single-head 12-needle embroidery machine engineered for boutiques, custom tailor shops, cap embroidery, and small batch production.
features: User-friendly touch screen with real-time stitch tracking
Includes cap frame driver, 2 cap rings, and 5 garment hoop sizes
Built-in LED sewing lamp with brightness adjustment
Quiet direct drive servo motor system

products.name: Shunfa Direct Drive Computerized Lockstitch Machine
products.description: High performance direct drive computerized single needle lockstitch machine featuring integrated control panel, energy saving motor, and automatic thread trimming.

specifications.Presser Foot Lift: 5.5 mm by hand / 13 mm by knee
specifications.Motor: Integrated Direct Drive AC Servo Motor 550W

features: Saves up to 70% electricity compared to clutch motor machines
Built-in needle positioner (UP/DOWN stop setting)
Integrated LED lamp with 3-level intensity control
Smooth needle bar stroke for flawless stitch quality on light to medium fabrics

products.name: Shunfa Advanced Lockstitch Machine with Voice Prompt
products.description: Smart computerized lockstitch machine equipped with voice assistance, automatic backtacking, auto foot lifter, and sealed oil reservoir.

specifications.Thread Trimming: Auto Trimmer with Double Rotating Knives

features: Voice guidance alerts operator for parameter adjustments and bobbin status
Short thread remaining tail (<3mm) after automatic trimming
Sealed oil pan prevents fabric oil staining
Electronic thread tension control for consistent seam appearance

products.name: Shunfa Heavy Duty Direct Drive Computerized Lockstitch
products.description: Heavy duty direct drive sewing machine engineered specifically for heavy materials including denim, canvas, thick curtains, leather, and bags.
features: Reinforced feed dog mechanism and heavy feed eccentric
Auto thread trimming and auto reverse backtacking for thick threads
High torque direct drive motor easily penetrates multi-layer denim
Extra clearance under arm for handling heavy cloth

products.name: Shunfa Smart Touch Computerized Sewing Machine
products.description: Sleek next-generation computerized sewing machine with digital touch button panel, electronic step motor stitch regulator, and ultra quiet operation.

specifications.Motor System: Dual Stepper Motor for Feed & Stitch Length

features: Stepper motor precise stitch regulation eliminates mechanical wear
Digital stitch length adjustment down to 0.1mm accuracy
Ornamental stitching capability for decorative collar/pocket seams
Ultra smooth motion with silent foot lifting
applications: Decorative stitching on coats, pockets & collars

products.name: Shunfa High Speed Direct Drive Overlock Machine
products.description: Super high speed direct drive overlock machine available in 4-thread and 5-thread configurations for clean edge trimmings and stretch seams.
features: Micro-adjust differential feed prevents fabric puckering or stretching
Needle bar oil-proof mechanism guarantees stainless garment output
Integrated LED illumination over needle plate zone
Instant speed response and energy-thrifty direct drive
applications: Jersey fabrics and elastic seam edging

products.name: Shunfa Compound Feed Walking Foot Lockstitch
products.description: Top and bottom compound feed walking foot heavy-duty lockstitch machine designed for non-slip sewing of thick leather, vinyl, and technical textiles.

specifications.Hook Type: Large Capacity Vertical Axis Rotary Hook

features: Alternating walking presser feet prevent slipping of sticky materials
Large bobbin holds twice as much thread for continuous thick thread sewing
Ideal for heavy leather, vinyl, thick webbing, and car seat cushions
Heavy duty cast iron body structure

products.name: High Quality Embroidery Threads & Metallic Cones
products.description: Premium grade 100% Trilobal Polyester and Viscose Rayon embroidery threads in 120 vibrant shade cones designed for high speed embroidery machines.

specifications.Compatibility: Tested up to 1200 RPM machine speed

features: Smooth knot-free unwinding prevents thread breakage during high speed embroidery
Excellent luster and color fastness against washing and bleaching
Includes metallic gold and silver specialty threads
applications: Saree borders, logos, badges and monogramming

Precision machined components for smooth operation
